name: Commercial Strategy & Financial Expansion Contract
description: Master prompt structure for business expansion, market entry, valuation models, and franchising.

required_sections.heading: Strategic Business Objective & Commercial Scope
required_sections.description: Target revenue, unit economics, market segment, and deliverable.

required_sections.heading: Operational Framework & Subsystem Topology
required_sections.description: Supply chain, unit operations, distribution channels, and governance.

required_sections.heading: Verifiable Acceptance Criteria
required_sections.description: Key performance indicators, financial thresholds, and auditability.

required_sections.heading: Output Format Specification
required_sections.description: Structured executive memorandum with unit economic schedules.

required_sections.heading: Commercial Self-Verification Checklist
required_sections.description: Checks validating pricing logic, risk reserves, and compliance boundaries.

required_sections.heading: Strategic Guardrails & Negative Constraints
required_sections.description: Guardrails against unrealistic margin assumptions and legal exposure.

required_sections.heading: Documented Commercial Assumptions
required_sections.description: Cost of capital, local market rates, and customer acquisition benchmarks.
